1.text: Gusenga kwa Mose, umuntu w'Imana.Mwami, ibihe byose wahoze uri ubuturo bwacu.

2.text: Imisozi itaravuka,Utararamukwa isi n'ubutaka,Uhereye iteka ryose ukageza iteka ryose,Ni wowe Mana.

3.text: Uhindura abantu umukungugu,Kandi ukavuga uti “Bana b'abantu, musubireyo.”

4.text: Kuko imyaka igihumbi mu maso yawe imeze nk'umunsi wejo wahise,Cyangwa nk'igicuku cy'ijoro.

5.text: Ubajyana nk'isūri bameze nk'ibitotsi,Bukeye bameze nk'ibyatsi bimera.

6.text: Mu gitondo birera bigakura,Nimugoroba bigacibwa bikuma.

7.text: Natwe uburakari bwawe bwatumazeho,Umujinya wawe waduhagaritse imitima.

8.text: Washyize ibyo twakiraniwe imbere yawe,N'ibyaha byacu byahishwe wabishyize mu mucyo wo mu maso hawe.

9.text: Kuko iminsi yacu yose ishize tukiri mu mujinya wawe,Imyaka yacu tuyirangiza nko gusuhuza umutima.

10.text: Iminsi y'imyaka yacu ni imyaka mirongo irindwi,Ariko kandi nitugira intege nyinshi ikagera kuri mirongo inani.Nyamara ibyiratwa byayo ni imiruho n'umubabaro,Kuko ishira vuba natwe tukaba tugurutse.

11.text: Ni nde uzi imbaraga z'uburakari bwawe,Akamenya umujinya wawe uko wowe ukwiriye kubahwa?

12.text: Utwigishe kubara iminsi yacu,Uburyo butuma dutunga imitima y'ubwenge.

13.text: Uwiteka garuka,Ko watinze uzageza ryari?Abagaragu bawe uduhindurire umutima.

14.text: Mu gitondo uzaduhaze imbabazi zawe,Kugira ngo tuzajye twishima tunezerwe iminsi yacu yose.

15.text: Utwishimishe ibyishimo bingana n'iminsi watubabarijemo,N'imyaka twabonyemo ibyago.

16.text: Umurimo wawe utubonekere abagaragu bawe,Gukomera kwawe kumenyekanire ku bana bacu.

17.text: Ubwiza bw'Uwiteka Imana yacu bube kuri twe,Kandi udukomereze imirimo y'intoki zacu,Nuko imirimo y'intoki zacu uyikomeze.
